pending_blockers.detail: FIXED_SOURCE is a forward-slash literal and workspace is assigned that unchanged. The helper canonicalizes the fixed path with System.IO.Path.GetFullPath and records that backslash Windows spelling in valid_input.path. parseNativeReply strictly compares that reply to workspace. A successful valid Shell selection therefore fails NATIVE_PATH_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED before Main binding or Task submission. Later Main/display exact comparisons also use the uncanonicalized literal.
pending_blockers.minimal_fix: Derive one canonical Windows fixed source with path.resolve/path.win32.normalize before using it as workspace, and use that exact spelling for helper-result/Main/display comparisons. Keep the independent fixed-location and no-reparse guards; do not loosen comparisons to arbitrary aliases.
